purpose: Develop scientifically substantive reusable representations of stochastic processes that certify adapted-OT proximity relations at lower total cost than separate transport computations; characterize the representation-size / guarantee-sharpness / decision-cost tradeoff.
priority_order: Scientific significance and distance from nearest prior art
Conditional/temporal mechanism for avoided or shared computation

scope_change.authority: User rejects positioning limited by completed prototypes, then explicitly requests saving this outcome-led scope, collecting comparison tools and defining research deliveries.
scope_change.legacy_solver_objective: Parked, neither achieved nor disproved. Its 0.5% value target and full grid bind only a separately labelled v2 solver claim.
scope_change.preservation: V3 and all earlier evidence retain their original targets and review boundaries; this amendment does not retroactively validate any result.

target.objects: Probability laws of stochastic processes with declared filtration on a finite horizon. Choose scientifically meaningful structural subclasses; existing finite k-window/AW1/transductive fixtures are prototype limits, not project-wide caps.
target.reference: Within each declared task, D(P,Q)=inf over bicausal couplings of E[sum_t c_t(X_t,Y_t)]. Identify D with AW_p^p only for matching costs and normalization. Initial execution remains finite-model adapted OT.
target.information: Declare access model per task. For path-observation comparisons charge reconstruction, labels, calibration and all oracle access. Supplied-model or generator-oracle experiments must be labelled separately and cannot imply path-input savings.
target.task_consistency: Freeze filtration/history, horizon, cost, p if applicable, units, normalization and model construction within each order task. AW_p and AW_p^p have the same ordering only within a fixed p task.
target.primary_decision: Mathematically guaranteed query-relative partial ordering according to D, with ties and unresolved cases explicit. Top-K, complete ranking and fallback are optional extensions, not completion requirements.
target.secondary_decisions: Global ordering of pair distances or clustering need separately frozen metrics and claims; one task does not validate another.
target.not_required: Each value accurate to 0.5%, exact equality with D, or a full all-pairs distance table.
target.population_boundary: Current executable certificates apply to the declared finite model only. General process-law theory is a research direction, not a population claim. A population or smoothed-estimand claim requires an explicit target selection and separately reviewed approximation/estimation bridge; no old experiment changes estimand.

primary.requirement: Every asserted strict comparison is valid for D under explicit checkable assumptions; top-K membership requires the same if that optional extension is selected. Unverified cases remain unresolved or invoke optional charged fallback.
allowed_routes: Direct ordering/distortion theorem with computable applicability test
Valid intervals or monotone-transformation bounds proving ordering
primary.interval_example: U(q,a)<L(q,b) certifies D(q,a)<D(q,b). This implication is elementary; obtaining useful information cheaply is the unresolved contribution.
primary.top_k: Optional only: prove selected items closer than excluded items, or specify a tie-aware set-valued output. ID tie breaking cannot certify an unresolved strict order.
primary.margin: Preregister margin/near-tie rules. Include unresolved or excluded near ties in reported denominators; stratify by margin rather than silently dropping hard pairs.
primary.quantitative_contribution: Characterize useful guarantee sharpness or distortion as a function of representation complexity or process structure on a nontrivial parameterized family; correctness on isolated fixtures alone is insufficient.

alternative.status: Select only by an explicit pre-run amendment, not by substitution after deterministic gates fail.
alternative.requirement: Declare sampling population, error event, confidence, calibration, simultaneous/adaptive-query validity and nontrivial coverage. Empirical correlation or bootstrap intervals alone are not distribution-free guarantees.

insufficient: Ordinary tree-Wasserstein distortion without a bicausal bridge
A lower bound alone used to assert ordering
Resolving everything with uncharged exact solves

mechanism_policy.candidate: Shared conditional-state trees are the current architectural investment. Upgrade or replace their representation/algorithm within the target if they cannot yield the intended contribution; a tree is not a mandatory final architecture.
mechanism_policy.known_baseline: Closed-form tree-Wasserstein is prior art. A trie does not enforce bicausality, and edge edit costs need not preserve reference costs.
mechanism_policy.novelty_gate: A useful substantive representation/guarantee/cost tradeoff for adapted decisions, explicit assumptions, adversarial discriminator and avoided work. Compare recursive WL/OTM/bisimulation and ordinary tree-OT prior art; generic recursive lifting, tree embedding, interval sorting or BRTDP transfer alone is insufficient.
mechanism_policy.representation_scope: Freeze training-only, database-built or transductive tree regime; charge query insertion/updates; held-out reference labels cannot shape the tree.
mechanism_policy.legacy_assets: Joint refinement, structured local OT, Gaussian oracle and rigorous arithmetic are supporting tools. Interaction compression is parked pending independent review, not universally refuted.

evaluation.breadth: A meaningful declared subclass is allowed, justified by mathematical or application structure rather than observed bound success. General claims must challenge nonmonotone second-order dependence and information-release timing. Prototype AW1/rational/k-window limits do not cap the project. V2 grid is an optional challenge pool.
required_challenges: Similar path geometry with different timing of information revelation, for claims of adapted-information benefit
Equal observations with different conditional futures, including higher-order dependence if claimed
Near/exact decision-boundary ties, with unresolved cases retained
Declare cost restriction; multiple p/costs are not universally mandatory
Scaling along axes carrying the claim, including representation size, horizon, database and query counts; long-horizon claims require long-horizon evidence
evaluation.splits: Split processes/trajectory sets into training, development/calibration and held-out confirmation groups. Derived pairs/triplets inherit object groups. Pair splits sharing objects are not independent generalization evidence; distinguish within-family and held-out-family claims.
evaluation.reference_protocol: Analytic/independently verified references on manageable cases. Float DP labels are numerical; overlapping reference intervals cannot establish strict ordering. Large-case guarantees require theory/numerics review, not universal full-DP labels.
primary_metrics: Certified coverage before fallback, unresolved/fallback fractions and final coverage
End-to-end time/work at matched guarantee and coverage
Expensive adapted-OT calls and continuation entries avoided
reports: amortized with database/query counts and break-even
comparators: Strong eligible same-target adapted-OT solvers with decision-aware early stopping; no unnecessary 0.5% precision
Nested Sinkhorn with a valid original-target certificate when an eligible adapter is available; disclose omissions and restrict comparative claims
Cheap valid bounds such as marginal OT lower and feasible coupling upper
Same decision pipeline with the proposed shared/avoided computation disabled
WL/OTM/bisimulation and learned approaches for closest-prior-art comparison; direct numerical comparison only after target alignment
evaluation.threshold_policy: Before each probe freeze numerical coverage/risk, material cost-reduction, margin/tie, sample-size, fallback and budget thresholds with rationale. Old v2 experiments do not satisfy these gates retroactively.
evaluation.comparator_readiness: Source availability, installation, numerical execution and certification eligibility are distinct. Do not discard a strong solver solely because its API lacks a certificate; evaluate and charge any feasible certificate adapter. Missing baseline implementation restricts claims; it does not certify superiority.

completion.scientific_weight_gate_first: Before implementation, state the successful paper-level claim, nearest theorem/algorithm, nontrivial remaining contribution and feasible decisive falsifier. Cheapness alone does not justify a probe.
required: D1: Independently assessed substantive claim and scientifically meaningful declared domain relative to nearest prior art
D2: Reviewed correct-target guarantee with a quantitative representation/structure versus sharpness result on a nontrivial family
D3: Reusable representation algorithm and implementation with explicit avoided work and full construction/query/update/certification cost
D4: Preregistered nontrivial coverage and material matched-guarantee/coverage total-cost advantage on held-out data, with adversarial controls and ablations
D5: Reproducible research report, claim-evidence map and honest limitations

research_outcomes.relational_research_objective_achieved: All positive v4 gates D1-D5 satisfied on a declared scientifically meaningful domain; no implication of v2 completion, universal process coverage or population validity.
research_outcomes.empirical_surrogate_result: Useful correlation/retrieval evidence without the required deterministic guarantee; exploratory, not v4 completion.
research_outcomes.scoped_negative_research_complete: A substantive independently reviewed limitation theorem on an explicit representation/algorithm class, access model, target and meaningful domain. Deliver D1/D5 plus theorem and appropriate sharpness/adversarial evidence replacing the positive-algorithm/speedup requirements in D2-D4. Report separately from achievement of the positive objective; failed probes alone are insufficient.
research_outcomes.limited_domain_result: Exact coverage and exclusions disclosed; no general claim beyond them.
research_outcomes.direction_stopped_evidence_based: Stop a tested construction with evidence and open questions, not an impossibility theorem.
research_outcomes.legacy_solver_objective_achieved: Requires every original v2 gate, separately evaluated against the immutable v2 snapshot.

orchestration.next_step: Use the live guarded checkpoint for the current decision. Align the current tree candidate with one substantive quantitative structural claim before a performance probe; do not restart historical queues.
task_gate: Is a cheaper decisive check available?
orchestration.routing: Root integrates; one bounded independent reviewer for a concrete claim, one implementer after that gate. No quota of agents or hypotheses.
orchestration.validator_boundary: workflow.py check-report supports v1/v2 numerical solver screening only and returns NOT_READY for schema >=3; no v4 scientific validator is claimed.
